about: SelfTune ST4 S2 (tasks/selftune-spec.md ST4): the 64 DICE-8B reference prompts. Written for this repo (license: the repo's own); the cuda prompts are KernelBench-style kernel-writing tasks, not copied from KernelBench. Each is one user turn, rendered with the model's chat template (add_generation_prompt=True) and encoded with add_special_tokens=False; sha256 is over the UTF-8 text.

prompts.text: Write a CUDA kernel that adds two float32 vectors of length N elementwise, plus the host code that launches it with 256 threads per block. Handle N that is not a multiple of the block size.
Write a CUDA kernel for ReLU over a float32 tensor of N elements, using a grid-stride loop. Show the launch configuration.
Implement a CUDA kernel that computes the sum of a float32 array of N elements using shared-memory tree reduction within each block, then a second launch to combine the block partial sums.
Write a CUDA kernel for a naive single-precision matrix multiply C = A * B, where A is M x K, B is K x N and all matrices are row-major. One thread computes one element of C.

Write a tiled CUDA matrix multiplication kernel using 16 x 16 shared-memory tiles for row-major float32 matrices whose dimensions are multiples of 16. Explain why tiling reduces global memory traffic.
Write a CUDA kernel that applies softmax to each row of a float32 matrix with R rows and C columns, one block per row. Make it numerically stable by subtracting the row maximum.

Implement LayerNorm over the last dimension of a float32 tensor of shape [rows, hidden] in CUDA, with learnable gamma and beta and epsilon 1e-5. Use one block per row and warp shuffles for the reductions.
Write a CUDA kernel computing RMSNorm: y = x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) * weight, for half-precision input of shape [tokens, 4096], accumulating in float32.
Write a CUDA kernel that transposes a 2D float32 matrix using shared memory with padding to avoid bank conflicts. The matrix is rows x cols with arbitrary sizes.

Implement a CUDA kernel for a 1D convolution: output[i] = sum over k of input[i + k] * filter[k], with a filter of length 7 stored in constant memory. Handle the boundary by treating out-of-range input as zero.
Write a CUDA kernel computing the elementwise GELU activation (tanh approximation) for a bfloat16 tensor, doing the math in float32.
Write a fused CUDA kernel that computes out = silu(gate) * up for two float16 tensors of the same shape, as used in the SwiGLU feed-forward layer.
Implement an exclusive prefix sum (scan) over an array of 1024 int32 values in a single CUDA block, using the Blelloch up-sweep and down-sweep algorithm in shared memory.
Write a CUDA kernel that computes a 256-bin histogram of an array of unsigned 8-bit values, using per-block shared-memory histograms and atomicAdd to merge them into global memory.

Write a CUDA kernel that applies rotary position embeddings to a query tensor of shape [tokens, heads, 128] in float16, given precomputed cos and sin tables of shape [tokens, 64]. Use the rotate-half convention.
Write a CUDA kernel that finds the argmax of each row of a float32 matrix of shape [batch, vocab] with vocab up to 152000, one block per row.
Write a CUDA kernel computing the cross-entropy loss for each row of a float32 logits matrix [batch, classes], given an int64 label per row. Use a numerically stable log-sum-exp.
Implement a CUDA kernel for 2D max pooling with a 2 x 2 window and stride 2 over a float32 tensor in NCHW layout.
Write a CUDA kernel that dequantizes int8 weights with one float32 scale per row into float16, for a weight matrix of shape [out_features, in_features].

Write a CUDA kernel computing scaled dot-product attention scores S = Q * K^T / sqrt(d) for one head, with Q of shape [q_len, 64] and K of shape [k_len, 64] in float32, followed by a causal mask that sets S[i][j] to -infinity when j > i.
Write a CUDA kernel that computes the L2 norm of each column of a row-major float32 matrix of shape [rows, cols], with coalesced memory access.
Implement a CUDA kernel performing an elementwise fused multiply-add out = a * b + c over float4 vectors to use 128-bit loads, with a scalar tail loop for the remainder.
Write a CUDA kernel that gathers rows of an embedding table of shape [vocab, 2560] in bfloat16 for a list of int32 token ids, writing a [tokens, 2560] output.
Write a CUDA kernel computing the cumulative sum along the last dimension of a float32 tensor [rows, 512], one warp per row, using warp shuffle instructions.
Explain in three paragraphs how a hash table handles collisions, comparing separate chaining with open addressing.
Write a Python function that returns the n-th Fibonacci number using an iterative loop, and explain its time complexity.
What is the difference between a process and a thread in an operating system? Give two examples of when you would prefer each.
Solve step by step: a train travels 180 km in 2 hours and then 120 km in 1.5 hours. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
Write a short poem of eight lines about a lighthouse keeper watching a storm.
Summarize the main causes of the French Revolution in five bullet points.
Write a SQL query that returns the five customers with the highest total order amount, given tables customers(id, name) and orders(id, customer_id, amount).
Explain what a closure is in JavaScript and give a small example that uses one to implement a counter.
A rectangle has a perimeter of 36 cm and its length is twice its width. Find its area, showing your work.
Write a Rust function that reverses the words in a sentence, keeping the words themselves unchanged.
Describe the water cycle to a ten-year-old in simple language.
What are the trade-offs between using a relational database and a document database for an online store?
Write a C function that checks whether a string is a palindrome, ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters.
Explain the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning, with one example of each.
Translate the following sentence into French and Spanish: The library opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
Write a bash script that counts the lines in every .txt file in the current directory and prints the total.
How does public-key cryptography allow two people to communicate securely without sharing a secret in advance?
Prove that the sum of the first n odd numbers equals n squared.
Write a Python class for a stack with push, pop, peek and is_empty methods, and include a short usage example.
Give a recipe for a simple vegetable soup, listing ingredients and steps.
Explain Big-O notation and compare O(n log n) with O(n^2) for n equal to one million.
Write a Go function that reads a file line by line and returns the number of lines that contain the word error.
What is the greenhouse effect, and why does carbon dioxide contribute to it?
Write a binary search in Python over a sorted list, returning the index of the target or -1 if it is absent.
Draft a polite email to a colleague asking to move a meeting from Tuesday to Thursday afternoon.
Explain how garbage collection by reference counting works and why it cannot free reference cycles on its own.
If a fair six-sided die is rolled twice, what is the probability that the sum is 8? Show the reasoning.
Write a TypeScript interface for a blog post with a title, a body, an author, tags and a publication date, and a function that filters posts by tag.
Explain the purpose of an index in a database and when adding one can slow a system down.
Write a short story of about 150 words about a robot that learns to paint.
What does the CAP theorem state about distributed systems? Explain each of the three properties.
Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists into one sorted list in linear time.
Explain how a CPU cache works and why accessing memory sequentially is faster than accessing it randomly.
Convert 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius and explain the formula.
Write a regular expression that matches dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD and explain each part.
List the planets of the solar system in order from the Sun, with one interesting fact about each.
Explain the difference between TCP and UDP and name an application suited to each.
Write a C++ function template that returns the maximum element of a std::vector, and handle the empty case.
What is gradient descent? Describe how the learning rate affects convergence.
Write a Python generator that yields the prime numbers below a given limit using the sieve of Eratosthenes.
